name: nexlearn
description: NexLearn — gamified, offline-friendly coding platform for Indian learners (Next.js app on Cloudflare Workers + Hono API + D1)

scripts.dev: bun --cwd frontend dev & bun --cwd backend dev
scripts.build: bun --cwd frontend build && bun --cwd backend build
scripts.lint: bun --cwd frontend lint && bun --cwd backend lint
scripts.cf:deploy-preamble: echo 'Manual/in-Linux deploys need wrangler; this repo deploys via Cloudflare Workers Builds from GitHub (see DEPLOY-CLOUDFLARE.md).'
